extOpenchannel.endpoint.enabledFailed: The endpoint may not have changed. Check its state above before you retry.
extOpenchannel.endpoint.noGrant: Your role has no access to this connector’s endpoint. An administrator can grant it.
extOpenchannel.endpoint.openFailed: The endpoint may not have opened. Check its state above before you retry.
extOpenchannel.endpoint.sub: Your own address on this installation. Nobody else can open, read or redirect it, and opening it again returns the same address.
extOpenchannel.endpoint.title: Your endpoint
extOpenchannel.error.capture_not_declare: This installation does not accept captures from this connector, and nothing on this screen can change that. Report it to whoever runs the installation.
extOpenchannel.error.capture_unavailable: The CRM capture pipeline could not be reached. Nothing was lost, and the next pass retries.
extOpenchannel.error.capture_record_gone: The CRM record this request would have landed on no longer exists, or it changed while the request waited. Nothing lands until the record is corrected.
extOpenchannel.error.delivery_blocked: Nothing was sent, because the registered address resolves to a private, reserved or loopback address. Register an address that resolves publicly.
extOpenchannel.error.delivery_refused: The registered address answered and declined the message.
extOpenchannel.error.delivery_unanswered: The message was sent and no answer came back. It is not retried, because a retry could deliver it twice.
extOpenchannel.error.drain_failed: Processing failed for a cause this connector does not classify yet. Report it with the process log of this job.
extOpenchannel.error.every_request_faile: No queued request reached the timeline this pass, and they did not stall for the same reason. Check the error on each request below.
extOpenchannel.error.member_not_permitte: Your access changed, so this request was not captured. Ask an administrator what you may capture.
extOpenchannel.error.payload_unusable: The sending system posted a format this connector does not accept. Whoever runs that system has to correct what it posts.
extOpenchannel.error.refused_by_the_core: The CRM rejected this message as invalid, so no timeline entry was created. Posting it again unchanged does not help.
extOpenchannel.inbound.empty: No requests have arrived at this endpoint yet.
extOpenchannel.inbound.noGrant: Your role has no access to incoming requests.
extOpenchannel.inbound.sub: The most recent requests, newest first. Only the size of each payload is shown, because an outside party chose its content.
extOpenchannel.inbound.title: Incoming requests
extOpenchannel.outbound.registerFailed: The address may not have been registered. Check the field above before you retry.
extOpenchannel.outbound.urlHint: An https address that names a host, not an IP address, with no credentials (they would be sent with every request) and no fragment. Registering it sends nothing.
extOpenchannel.outboundList.empty: No messages have been sent from this endpoint yet.
extOpenchannel.outboundList.noGrant: Your role has no access to outgoing messages.
extOpenchannel.outboundList.sub: The most recent messages this connector posted to the registered address, newest first. Each message body is on the CRM record it was sent from.
extOpenchannel.outboundList.title: Outgoing messages
extOpenchannel.recipe.demoBody: A message posted from outside to confirm that the endpoint verifies signatures.
extOpenchannel.recipe.secretInProcessArg: openssl takes the key as a command-line argument, so on a shared host anyone else can see it in the process list while the command runs. Its HMAC option cannot read the key from an environment variable or from stdin. Run the command only on a host you do not share, or sign the request another way.
Secret visible on a shared host
extOpenchannel.recipe.signedOver: The signature is the hex-encoded HMAC-SHA256 of {material}, keyed with the signing secret. Send it as sha256=<hex>. The timestamp is in Unix seconds and must be recent, and each nonce can be used once.
extOpenchannel.recipe.sub: Point a sending system at the address below and sign each request it posts. Any request without a valid signature is refused, whoever sent it.
extOpenchannel.recipe.title: Sending to your endpoint
extOpenchannel.recipe.urlNotSecret: Like any other path, the address appears in access logs and in every proxy between a sender and this installation. Share it with whoever configures the sender: only the signing secret authenticates a request.
extOpenchannel.recipe.urlNotSecretTitle: This address is not a credential
extOpenchannel.secret.mintFailed: Either no new secret was minted and the previous one still verifies, or one was minted and every sender configured with the previous secret has stopped working. Mint again: it is safe, and it is the only way to see a secret you can use.
extOpenchannel.secret.shownOnce: It cannot be shown again. Copy it into the sender now. Minting another secret stops this one from verifying.
extOpenchannel.sub: A signed POST from an outside system with no account on this installation lands on the CRM timeline. Messages the CRM sends back are signed the same way.
extOpenchannel.title: Open channel
